    """Convert a title into a URL-friendly slug."""
    s = title.lower()
    s = s.replace('&', ' and ')
    s = ''.join(c for c in s if c.isascii() and (c.isalpha() or c.isdigit() or c in ' -'))
    
    # Turn each run of spaces and hyphens into one hyphen
    result = []
    in_run = False
    for c in s:
        if c in ' -':
            if not in_run:
                result.append('-')
                in_run = True
        else:
            result.append(c)
            in_run = False
    s = ''.join(result)
    
    # Strip hyphens from both ends
    s = s.strip('-')
    
    # Truncate to 40 characters and strip trailing hyphen
    if len(s) > 40:
        s = s[:40]
        s = s.rstrip('-')
    
    return s
